Command.Name: StoreEJByDate
Command.FPOperation: Store Electronic Journal Report from report from date to date to External USB, External SD card.

Arg.Name: OptionReportStorage

Option.Name: Storage in External SD card memory
Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Desc: 2 symbols for destination: - 'J4' - Storage in External SD card memory - 'JX' - Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Name: StartRepFromDate
Arg.Desc: 6 symbols for initial date in the DDMMYY format

Arg.Name: EndRepFromDate
Arg.Desc: 6 symbols for final date in the DDMMYY format
